snippet.title: Websy and the Time Rogues - Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam! https://store.steampowered.com/app/3018720/Websy_and_the_Time_Rogues/

Websy and the Time Rogues is an action roguelike game about a tiny spider swinging through levels, webbing enemies and collecting powerful items from across time and space. Players hop between the past, the present and the future, fighting swarms of evil bugs as they combine items into unique and sometimes paradoxical builds. Master the fast, fluid swinging and build up speed to become an unstoppable whirlwind of attacks, weaving through enemies and stringing them together for combos!
